small: every letter lights one more star
hold the line and keep typing
our station will not fall today
calm hands beat any cosmic storm
no comet ever scared this crew
aim with care then fire again
medium: meteors fall when nobody looks at the sky
each correct word protects our little planet
between two galaxies there is only silence
breathe slowly before your next bright shot
the engines sing while your fingers dance
this great wall only breaks with patience
far away another pilot practices tonight
when all lights go out the hands remember
large: seven sleepy engineers defend an entire floating city
no ship may cross this shield without our permission
speed is helpful but precision always wins the battle
the oldest stars still shine above our silent towers
every great traveler once began with one small step
our computer guards one secret map of the universe
when another wave arrives we take one breath together
for each asteroid we destroy new questions are born
